what: These are the bytes v0.5.5 published, copied here so a reader can check the page against something that is not the page. The page was opened as a draft so an immutable release could still accept uploads, and the pin step failed on that draft (it asked /releases/tags, which answers 404 for drafts); this directory and anchors/pins/uibc-release-v0.5.5.json are the repository forms of what the page holds.

tsa.detail: anchor_freetsa.tsr is on the release; verify with tools/check_release_anchors.py, which needs the network

ots.detail: CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt.ots as the page serves it (670 bytes)

limits: A signature says which key signed these bytes, not who controls that key outside this repository. The timestamp states what the token says; neither proves who published the page or that the workflow behaved.
